description: Stage 1 of Milestone 4: reconstructs opportunities (Milestone 1), computes causal features (Milestone 2) and resolves outcomes for all three quick-profit geometries, restricted to exactly the (symbol, session) pairs the Milestone 2 universe audit included. Produces one labeled row per (opportunity, geometry).
real_run_note: The real run against the full frozen 5,999-symbol-session cohort completed 27 September 2026, taking roughly 7 hours (well beyond the ~3.85-hour estimate from a 45-session profiling sample - the full-scale run evidently scales worse than linearly in some component, most likely the peer-universe lookups, though this was not root-caused further since the run still completed correctly). pooled_label_rate (22.66%) is the RAW, UNSELECTED strict-success rate across every resolved (opportunity, geometry) row pooled together - it is not an AEM v2 accuracy result and must not be read as one: no selector (Milestone 3's Precision Ladder) has been applied yet. That requires Stage 2's pipeline race, which this real dataset now feeds.
sizing_note: Uses a simple fixed-risk quantity (0.5% of trading capital per trade, matching CLAUDE.md's stated breakeven reference) for accuracy determination, not the portfolio-constrained replay a later stage could add if this result is promising enough to warrant it.
corrections: Extracted the real-data loading (universe audit + Milestone 1 manifest + staged minute/daily bars) into a new public load_real_session_sources() so the mandatory execution-stress replay (aem_v2_stress_gates.py) reads through the exact same verified path rather than a second, divergent loader. build_development_dataset's own behavior and output are unchanged - this only removes duplication. fixed_risk_quantity was also made public (was _fixed_risk_quantity) for the same reason.

decision.reason: This evidence file pins the dataset-assembly code, its tests, and now the real run's dataset statistics. It intentionally contains no accuracy, availability or economics result for AEM v2 itself - that requires the walk-forward pipeline race (Stage 2) this dataset exists to support, which is a separate checkpoint.
